name: delamux/cakephp-basecoat-theme
description: CakePHP 5 theme plugin for Basecoat UI (shadcn/ui look, no React): one configurable View Helper per component.

suggest.cakephp/bake: Ready-made screens (bin/cake bake screen) and the Basecoat CRUD bake templates (--theme BasecoatTheme)
suggest.friendsofcake/search: List search and filters in baked lists (BasecoatTheme.Contains/Equals/DateRange filters, ListFilter)
